name: pm-vcs
description: A version control system written from scratch on the pm SDK: its own content-addressed object store, refs, Myers diff, three-way merge, operation log and bundles, with no shell-out to git. Structured records are a first-class object kind and merge per field, so many agents on many branches converge without a line merge anywhere in the pipeline. Commands: `pm vcs init/status/add/commit/log/diff/branch/switch/merge/tag/undo/oplog/export/import/verify` operate on pm-vcs repositories; `pm vcs git preflight/preview/items` is the git-interoperability surface.
author: @unbraind
